description: This is a Dart source file defining an AuthProvider class that manages authentication state, interacts with AuthService, and notifies UI components of state changes.

classes.name: AuthProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages authentication state, user data, and loading status using an injected AuthService.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the provider and retrieves the current user.

methods.name: currentUser
methods.description: Getter for the current authenticated user, nullable.

methods.name: isAuthenticated
methods.description: Returns true if a user is currently authenticated.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Asynchronously signs in a user with email and password, updating state and notifying listeners.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Asynchronously registers a new user with name, email, and password, updating state and notifying listeners.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Asynchronously signs out the current user and updates the state.

methods.name: updateProfile
methods.description: Asynchronously updates the current user's profile with provided data.
